name: @hmharness/extension
description: hmharness browser-extension bridge — a loopback server + pairing flow (the ChatGPT desktop-app ↔ extension pattern) that lets the agent see and, with approval, act in the user's REAL browser tabs across Chrome/Edge/Brave (MV3 service worker + side panel), Firefox (MV3 event page + sidebar), and Safari (popup payload via safari-web-extension-converter). Zero runtime dependencies.
